gloss: wide range; extensive area; broad scope

definitions.gloss: wide range; extensive area; broad scope
definitions.explanation: A large area or scope, whether physical, conceptual, or in terms of impact. Often used as a no-adjective to modify nouns.

examples.japanese: {広範囲|こうはんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{及|およ}んだ→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧。
examples.english: The impact extended over a wide area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広範囲|こうはんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらした→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon caused damage over an extensive area.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広範囲|こうはんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This medicine is said to be effective against a broad range of bacteria.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in news reports, scientific writing, and formal contexts. Often combined with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって (over, spanning) or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広範囲|こうはんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる (to span a wide range)
- {広範囲|こうはんい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{及|およ}ぶ→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧ (to extend over a wide area)
- {広範囲|こうはんい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (widespread damage)
- {広範囲|こうはんい}な⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (extensive survey)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広範|こうはん}→広範：12479_kouhan⟧: wide-ranging — similar but used as a na-adjective
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧: wide, broad — more everyday term
